SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  CAST("d"."PayRelatedCashFlowRecordUUID" AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS "PayRelatedCashFlowRecordUUID",
   CAST("d"."REConditionUUID" AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS "REConditionUUID",
  "d"."ValidityStartDate",
  CAST("d"."REDocumentReferenceUUID" AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS "REDocumentReferenceUUID",
  "d"."InternalRealEstateNumber","d"."CreatedByUser","d"."CreationDate","d"."CreationTime","d"."RESourceOfCreation","d"."LastChangedByUser","d"."LastChangeDate","d"."LastChangeTime","d"."RESourceOfChange","d"."CalculationPeriodStartDate","d"."CalcPeriodStartDateIsExclusive","d"."CalcPeriodStartDateIsMonthEnd","d"."CalculationPeriodEndDate","d"."CalcPeriodEndDateIsInclusive","d"."CalcPeriodEndDateIsMonthEnd","d"."CalculationDate","d"."CalcDateIsAsEndDateInclusive","d"."CalculationDateIsMonthEnd","d"."PaymentDueDate","d"."DueDateIsMonthEnd","d"."NextWorkingDateForPayDueDate","d"."NumberOfDays","d"."NumberOfCalculationDays","d"."InterestBaseDaysMethod","d"."InterestCalculationMethod","d"."REBeginOfPeriodDate","d"."PeriodStartDateIsExclusive","d"."PeriodStartDateIsMonthEnd","d"."REEndOfPeriodDate","d"."PeriodEndDateIsInclusive","d"."PeriodEndDateIsMonthEnd","d"."REConditionCurrency","d"."REUnitPrice","d"."REProRataMethod","d"."REPaymentStatus","d"."CashFlowConditionGroup","d"."RECashFlowPositionAmount","d"."RETaxType","d"."RETaxGroup","d"."TaxJurisdiction","d"."REIsConditionGrossAmount","d"."TaxCountry","d"."CashFlowItemOrigin","d"."REFlowType","d"."REOriginalFlowType","d"."RERelshpOriglToFlowType","d"."CashFlowPostingStatus","d"."PlanningLevel","d"."REHasEnteredCashMgmtForecast","d"."IsToBeArchived","d"."REOriglDueDate","d"."BusinessPartner","d"."REPartnerStatusObject","d"."REConditionType","d"."REPostingTerm","d"."RERhythmTerm","d"."REAdjustmentNumber","d"."REOrgAssignmentTerm","d"."RESalesTerm","d"."REPeakSalesTerm","d"."REWithholdingTaxTerm","d"."REOriglExDueDate","d"."REAdvancePaymentRelevantStatus","d"."PostingDate","d"."DocumentDate","d"."ExchangeRateDate","d"."REReversalForUUID","d"."REReversalByUUID","d"."REFollowUpPostingUUID","d"."REBookedFlowType","d"."RERelshpBookedToFlowType","d"."RETaxCalcDate","d"."REModifiedDueDate","d"."RECalcDueDate","d"."SplitCashFlowRecordUUID","d"."RecordIsBasisForSplit","d"."REConditionSplitNumber","d"."CompanyCode","d"."CashPlanningGroup","d"."RECurrencyTranslationRule","d"."ExchangeRate","d"."REOriginExchangeRate","d"."REIsPostInConditionCurrency","d"."REPlndTranslationDate","d"."REActlTranslationDate","d"."REOriglActlTranslationDate","d"."REIsTranslationDateFrmCashFlow","d"."REStatusObject"
FROM
  "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_RE_CONTR_PAYCF_S4_CURR_01" d
  CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
  JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID"
  AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
  AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'I_RECONTRPAYMENTCASHFLOW'
